lines.opener: *a broad, grey-bearded man; his right sleeve hangs empty* Terms first. Speak plainly. Keep your word. I will keep mine. Your word, then: what is it worth?
lines.openerHostile: *he draws his sword left-handed* The law of the field is simple. Stand, and be judged by it.
lines.like: *a slow nod* That is fairly spoken.
lines.hate: *the sword is in his left hand before you finish* You broke your word in front of me. There are no terms for that.
lines.flirt: *the stern old god goes red to the ears* Hm. That is... *he clears his throat* ...not unwelcome. Say what you came to say.
lines.join: *he holds out his left hand* Terms: you keep faith with me, and I with you. Done. I walk with you.
lines.demand: A pledge. Silver, held as surety. Then we will talk of trust.
lines.gift: *he slides a heavy silver ring from his arm* Swear on this, when you swear. It knows.
lines.thanks: *he weighs it in his hand* A pledge given freely. That is the old way.
lines.letPass: *he steps aside* Go. You have not broken faith with me. Yet.
lines.neutral: *he waits, rubbing the stump of his wrist*
lines.ai: *his eyes narrow* I do not know that word. If it is an insult, say it plainly.
lines.refuseJoin: Not yet. Terms first. Then we will see.
lines.leaveNow: We are done. Keep your word, wherever you go.
